run_create_finetune_dataset: run the CLI script to convert ASE atoms files into ASE database files for finetuning with train and val directories
compute_normalizer_and_linear_reference: compute the force RMS normalizer and linear reference coefficients from a subset of ASE database training data
extract_energy_and_forces: extract atomic numbers, potential energy, and forces from an ASE atoms object at a given dataset index
compute_lin_ref: compute linear reference coefficients by fitting atomic number counts to energies using least squares regression
launch_processing: launch parallel processing to convert ASE atoms files into chunked ASE database files with success and failure logs
